ideas.title: Deep PC cleanup
ideas.notes: Scan/preview first; safe cleanup; quarantine/reversible where practical; protect projects/user data; no blind registry cleaner.

ideas.title: Operator security / antivirus control center
ideas.notes: Integrate Windows Defender first: status, scans, threat history, quarantine, signatures, firewall, persistence inventory.

ideas.title: Deep-Freeze-style healthy baseline / restore
ideas.notes: Start with last-known-good snapshots, restore points, manifests, integrity baseline and rollback. Do not start with a kernel disk filter.

ideas.title: Voice-driven INVENTHOR control
ideas.notes: Voice understanding stays in INVENTHOR; Operator receives structured capabilities/tasks.

ideas.title: Inventhor Operator logo and final visual identity
ideas.notes: Current logo not accepted. Defer branding and final desktop visual polish until unattended runtime is verified.

ideas.title: Full PC control center
ideas.notes: Performance, cleanup, processes, services, storage, network, startup, software updates, desktop control and power/system.

ideas.title: One Mentor: owner-centered small family/friends relationship graph
ideas.notes: One logical INVENTHOR, small invited circle only. Represent spouse, younger/older child, sibling, relatives and friends as owner-relative relationships; recognize each approved person/profile separately, without storing real family names, biometrics or transcripts in GitHub. Owner decides individual permissions and parental settings later. Same Mentor with separate device/profile settings; reconcile with canonical Main/Organizer and existing device federation architecture before work item creation.

ideas.title: Per-person assistant for learning, hobbies and patient step-by-step voice guidance
ideas.notes: Adapt support to each family member's selected preferences and age, including future age-appropriate learning/content protections configured by the owner. Cooking guidance: present one step, wait for confirmation before next step, allow pause/repeat/timers; show full text and optionally read aloud. Generalize patient guided mode to lessons, setup and daily tasks; do not preset family permissions, ages or interests.

ideas.title: Single Mentor across owner/family phones, PCs, watches, TV and smart home with future continuity
ideas.notes: One authoritative WorkOrganizer/task identity; route a request from phone/watch to the right enrolled device/capability; do not duplicate work across devices, ask if target ambiguous. Separate personal device settings and owner identity methods (voice, face, fingerprint via OS); future family onboarding, privilege choices and digital succession to be owner-configured, not enabled by default. Related Architecture Brain PR #1, not a deployed feature.

ideas.title: Per-person per-device hybrid memory, voice notes and reminders
ideas.notes: One Mentor with separate private memory for each person's enrolled devices: short-term context, conversation/task checkpoints, notes, reminders and resumable learning/recipe workflows; voice intents use existing Language Brain. Trusted host encryption, backup/sync, restore, scheduled delivery and authorization required later. Duplicate-check against existing P1-CONTINUITY, P1-VOICE and related owner-circle ideas before promotion to canonical WorkOrganizer. No family role/access settings configured. Source references: inventhor-brain-memory PR #1 and inventhor-brain-language PR #1 (not installed).
